content: Google DeepMind released AlphaGenome Atlas, a comprehensive database predicting the effects of all 9 billion potential single-nucleotide mutations in the human genome. This system generates 240 trillion prediction values, significantly exceeding AlphaFold’s scale. By integrating multi-layered analysis and accessible web interfaces, Atlas enables researchers to identify disease-causing variants without specialized computational resources. Initial applications include resolving undiagnosed pediatric epilepsy cases and enhancing rare variant analyses in large biobanks, streamlining genomic research and accelerating the discovery of non-coding regulatory mechanisms.

title: 刚刚，OpenAI 宣布攻克千禧年难题，清华姚班传奇陈立杰：不可思议的时代
content: OpenAI announced its AI system solved the Navier-Stokes existence and smoothness Millennium Prize Problem, generating a formal proof. This achievement utilized approximately 10,000 collaborating AI agents, consuming massive computational resources over nearly 90 hours. The announcement sparked controversy regarding research priority, as fluid dynamics expert Tristan Buckmaster claimed prior progress on related equations using AI models. OpenAI denied using user data, asserting its solution was independent. This event highlights the rapid advancement of AI in mathematical research, challenging traditional academic attribution and verification standards.
